question: What initial yogic practice at the root wheel begins the sequence of experiential signs?
premises: The root wheel is named as the first locus.
Practice is undertaken at that stage.
The beloved is addressed as the instruction begins.
inference: The sequence begins when one first practices at the root wheel.
uncertainties: The fused forms mūlacakrantu and yadānyabhyasate are read according to the transmitted text.
plain_english: O beloved, first, when one practices at the root wheel...
